name: Collins
note: Taller and narrower than a highball, for the same reason and more of it.
iceDisplacementNote: Solid ice only, filled to the top as a highball is. Crushed is taken as 7% above cubed: loose crushed ice weighs about 593 to 640 kg per cubic metre against 917 for solid ice, roughly 65% solid, where loose cubes run about 61%.
